title: The Dangers in My Heart
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Kyotaro Ichikawa is a gloomy middle-school loner who reads murder encyclopedias and fantasizes about killing his popular classmates, especially the class idol Anna Yamada. As he watches her, he finds she is quirky, kind and lonely in her own way, and as she grows friendly toward him the fantasies fade into a slow, awkward first love.
life_message: It holds up letting someone see you as you are, and growing kinder and braver through first love.

content.note: Kyotaro imagines stabbing classmates early on; the fantasies fade after the first volume (Wikipedia; ANN Cormack; UK Anime Network).
Dark inner monologue played against comedy (ANN).

Middle-school romance; jokes about erections and masturbation, classmates' sexual games, Anna sometimes drawn suggestively though 'not particularly ecchi' (ANN Cormack; UK Anime Network; MangaDex suggestive).
Crude adolescent talk (ANN); profanity level to verify.
Social anxiety and morbid fantasies as a coping strategy, which ease as Kyotaro connects with others (ANN; Wikipedia).
Murder-fantasy 'edgelord' persona treated as phase; reviewers wished it toned down (Wikipedia reception).
